title: registry_entry
description: One entry of research/registry.json (Implementation Decisions 10): a skill or a role the librarian may assign, from either scope. The registry is regenerated by `wayline registry build` and at every planner launch, so an entry is never edited by hand: `capability_summary`, `applicability_tags`, `cost_hint`, and `fixtures` come from the artifact's `wayline.json` sidecar, `sha256` is recomputed from the artifact's files, and `outcome` is computed from the journal's `ticket_launched` and `ticket_done` or `ticket_failed` pairs.

id.description: the skill's or role's name, which is also its directory name

scope_kind.description: global is the harness repository, local is the project's .claude/

path.description: the artifact's directory, relative to the scope root it was found under

sha256.description: recomputed over every file of the artifact's directory except the sidecar, so an edited skill is a changed entry

kinds.description: the ticket kinds this artifact is for; an empty list means the librarian never assigns it by kind, which is what the interactive phase skills carry

fixtures.description: fixture ids in the Implementation Decisions 12 layout, `<kind>/<slug>`

assigned.description: launches this artifact was named in

passed_first_time.description: tickets that reached done on the attempt this artifact was first named in

last_used.description: the ts of the most recent launch naming it

assignable.description: false for a local model-authored skill with no passing fixture, and for an artifact whose sidecar or files the build could not read

problems.description: why the build set assignable false, or what the structural pre-check reported
